description: This Java class defines a message type 'CheckForActivity' used within an actor system to monitor activity and determine if the actor should terminate itself due to inactivity.

classes.name: CheckForActivity
classes.description: A message class used by the Actor to check its activity status based on a sequence number.

methods.name: CheckForActivity
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message with the current sequence number.

methods.name: getSequenceNr
methods.description: Returns the sequence number captured when the message was created.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare CheckForActivity instances based on sequence number.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to produce hash based on sequence number.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation including the class name and sequence number.
